question: Which edition of National Voters’ Day was celebrated on 25 January 2025 to commemorate the foundation day of the Election Commission of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**15th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Voters' Day** is celebrated every year on **25th January** to mark the foundation day of the **Election Commission of India (ECI)**, which was established on **25th January 1950**.
 
• The celebration aims to increase awareness among voters and encourage participation in the **electoral process**.
 
• The **15th edition** of National Voters' Day was observed on **25th January 2025**, commemorating the **75th anniversary** of the Election Commission of India.
 
• The theme for National Voters' Day often highlights voter awareness and inclusive participation in democratic processes. For the **15th edition**, the focus was likely on strengthening democratic values.
 
• The day is marked by **special activities**, including voter education campaigns, distribution of voter ID cards to new voters, and cultural events across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Election Commission of India (ECI):**

 
 
• The **ECI** is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering **elections** to Parliament, State Legislatures, and the offices of the President and Vice President in India.
 
• It was established on **25th January 1950** under **Article 324** of the Constitution of India.
 
• The Commission consists of the Chief Election Commissioner and two Election Commissioners, who are appointed by the President of India.
 
• ECI plays a crucial role in ensuring free and fair elections in India.
 
 
 
• **Importance of National Voters' Day:**
 
 
• The day seeks to emphasize the importance of voting and the role of voters in the democratic process.
 
• It is aimed at increasing voter enrollment, especially among **young voters**, and ensuring their active participation in elections.
 
• Distribution of **Electoral Photo Identity Cards (EPICs)** to newly registered voters is a key activity.
 
• Educational campaigns are organized to spread awareness about the significance of voting and responsible citizenship.
 
 
 
• **Themes of National Voters' Day:**
 
 
• The themes of National Voters' Day often focus on inclusivity, transparency, and voter awareness.
 
• Past themes have included "Making Our Voters Empowered, Vigilant, Safe and Informed" and "Electoral Literacy for Stronger Democracy."
 
• These themes highlight the Election Commission's efforts to promote informed and ethical voting practices.
 
 
 
• **Role of Young Voters:**
 
 
• Young voters are the backbone of democratic participation, and the day encourages their enrollment and active participation.
 
• Special campaigns are run to ensure every eligible individual between the age of **18-21 years** is registered as a voter.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Historical Milestones:**

 
 
• National Voters' Day was first celebrated in **2011** to commemorate the foundation day of the **Election Commission of India**.
 
• It has since become an important annual event to promote voter awareness and democratic participation.
 
 
 
• **Voter Turnout:**
 
 
• India has one of the largest electorates globally, and ensuring high voter turnout is a continuous effort by the ECI.
 
• National Voters' Day plays a significant role in encouraging **eligible citizens** to exercise their franchise.
